Name: dizzi Vanilla Portrait Box
Author: dizziRD
Description:
Alecto, Leilani, Jas, Aideen and Tempysta ship their portraits as 4x sheets
(256px cells). Dialogue Display Framework Continued renders dialogue portraits
into a fixed 64x64 box, so with those NPCs it displayed an enlarged fragment
instead of the face.

This pack sets the framework's own official 'disabled' flag for those five NPCs,
so they use the vanilla dialogue box. No configuration of your own is read or
written, and no assets are added.

This pack contains no artwork. It ships one manifest.json and one content.json
that set five flags in the framework's dictionary. Every portrait and sprite you
see comes from the original author's mod, already installed on your machine.

Why the portrait authors don't ship this themselves: correcting it would mean
releasing a patch that overrides their own work. That would break their users
who don't want it, so it isn't something they can reasonably ship. Load-order
and compatibility shims are nobody's job, so almost nobody writes them.

Requires: Content Patcher 2.3.0+, SMAPI 4.0.0+
Compatible with: Dialogue Display Framework Continued (0.7.5+)

The five NPCs are found by portrait name, so this works for any mod that
provides those portraits.

Manifest.Name: dizzi Vanilla Portrait Box
Manifest.Description: Excluye a Alecto, Leilani, Jas, Aideen y Tempysta de Dialogue Display Framework Continued con el flag oficial 'disabled', para que DDFC use la caja de dialogo vanilla del juego en esos NPCs. Sus retratos son sheets 4x (celdas de 256) y DDFC 0.7.5 recorta la fuente con w/h por defecto de 64, lo que producia un fragmento ampliado del portrait en vez de la cara. Solo afecta a estos 5 NPCs: el resto (Pretty Anime, OO's, Genderbends, los de SVE que usan celdas de 64) siguen usando DDFC normalmente.
